## Live replacement

**Live file swap: none.** No installable PS3 build: re5ps3 writers emit ARCs offline only ('complete folder-game mod/export ... runtime acceptance' open). RPCS3 adapters do have save_state (F2 save-and-continue) and load_state = relaunch, so keep-the-moment is mechanically possible.

**Pick whip: none.** No RE5 PS3 entity reader in pick_tool; tools.MAIN_RAM has no ps3 layout. Enemies are nameable by RAM class (sEnemy + getDTI, mercs/enemy_identity.class_of) and the camera is read, but no world-to-screen projection or class -> archive swap exists.

**Live controls:** re5_mods (MCP game_mod): turn_speed, fire_rate x1-80, infinite_ammo, unlimited_health, infinite_spray, bullet_damage, loadout, weapon_override, live_weapon, rotten_egg_only, select/random_weapon, mines, kill/add/set_time, mercs_select (next menu), revert_all.

## Gaps before a live swap / pick whip

- No modified PS3 ARC has ever been installed or booted in RPCS3: writers are offline-only and there is no folder-game mod/overlay launch path.
- Writers cover two packs (Chris and Sheva normal); other costumes, Jill/Wesker/Excella (non-finite UVs), Irving (vertex type 4), NPCs and enemies have none.
- No live model/costume/character RAM swap; the character only changes through the native menu (mercs_select, native_start_verified=false).
- Active-round bow/egg pickup conversion unverified (needs a spare ownerless ammo pickup and a free slot; no native give-item mailbox).
- Pick whip needs a ps3 MAIN_RAM layout, a projection from sBioCamera eye/look-at, and a uEm class -> uEm##.arc mapping.
- Revision split: live addresses measured on app 01.01; offline writers pin the disc 01.00 EBOOT/packs.
- Fitted donors: shader, motion, culling, camera clearance unproven; merc_live_controls (PineLive) sliders are Switch-only.
